senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (इ) इभि (इम्भयते)
To collect or accumulate.

m. (-भः)
1 An elephant.
2 Best (in composition.)
E.
इण to go, भन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-णा)
A plant with an aromatic seed, (Pothos officinalis.)
E.
इभ an elephant, and कणा pepper; being considered by Hindu writers, as a large species of pepper: see गजपिप्पली.

f. (-न्ता)
A plant: see नागदन्ती.
E.
इभ and दन्त a tooth: this and similar names are given, from its supposed resemblance to an elephant's tooth.

f. (-का)
Smartness, shrewdness, wittiness.
E.
इभ and निभनिमीलिका winking; winking knowingly like an elephant.

m. (-कः)
The driver or keeper of an elephant.
E.
इभ, पालक a nourisher.

f. (-टा)
A young elephant, a cub.
E.
इभ and पोटा any young animal.

m. (-लः)
A lion.
E.
इभ an elephant, in the second case, आ and चल who attacks.

f. (-तिः)
An elephant's cub.
E.
इभ and युवति young.

m. (-ख्यः)
A plant, (Mesua ferrea): see नागकेशर.
E.
इभ and आख्या an appellation; named from the elephant.
